meta.description: The window of quevu as a dynamic library with a C interface, written in Rust on native toolkits (Win32 working; GTK and Cocoa not written yet): tabs the application opens (pseudo-consoles over logs, tables of controls with lights and verbs), menus and tray icon, all in the words of the application. Use when working with the quevu-ui Cargo workspace, quevu_ui.h, quevu_ui.dll, or when writing a new backend.
